name: nightzpy-plugins
description: Single-plugin marketplace hosting the explanatory-animations Claude Code plugin. Add with /plugin marketplace add .

plugins.name: explanatory-animations
plugins.description: Build polished interactive animated explanations and content-creator effects from natural-language prompts. 16 patterns (lifecycles, system flows, algorithms, mechanical motion, orbits, particles, LLM internals, math, geographic maps, cross-sections, timelines, text effects, counters, shape morph, line drawing). Self-contained HTML widgets (Anime.js v4), in-browser Export button, autonomous MP4 renderer, optional Remotion Studio.
